🇲🇽🚆 <u>CDMX METRO: 937 MILLION PESOS FOR STATIONS, RAIN WORKS, LINE 12 CHECKUP</u>

The Metro’s annual works program is in the Gaceta Oficial: over 937 million pesos, including 65 million for the full renovation of Universidad station on Line 3, 550 million for Line 2 stations readied for the World Cup, 126 million to mitigate rain damage, and 232 million in waterproofing across the network.

Line 12’s reinforced elevated viaduct gets a full structural inspection — the line the neoliberals built with defects and never answered for. Maintenance is what a government owes its city.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>ZAPATISTAS HOST DELEGATES FROM 28 COUNTRIES IN CHIAPAS</u>

While Washington convenes summits against “extreme-left terrorism,” delegates from 28 countries gathered in Zapatista territory for the EZLN’s international encuentro of critical thought, art and rebellion. Subcomandante Moisés opened it with the diagnosis no one at those summits will say out loud: capitalism is responsible for the wars.

32 years after the uprising, the caracoles still draw the world.

🇲🇽⚡ <u>CFE CLOSES H1 WITH 47.6 BILLION PESOS IN PROFIT</u>

Mexico’s state power utility reported 47,623 million pesos in net profit for the first half of 2026, on revenues of 332,229 million — the 30.7% annual dip comes from lower natural gas prices cutting fuel sales to third parties, not from operations, CFE told the BMV.

Profitable, public, and funding the grid instead of shareholders. El Economista has the numbers.

🇲🇽🍋 <u>VERACRUZ LIME TO THE US AND RUSSIA: 40 TONS</u>

Mexico will export 40 tons of Veracruz lime to the United States and Russia, El Soberano reports — weeks after Sembrando Vida producers in Papantla shipped Mexican lime to Russia for the first time.

While Washington talks decoupling, Mexican producers are opening markets from Florida to Moscow.

Diversification isn’t a slogan. It’s a shipment.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>CJNG ORDERED MAYOR MANZO’S MURDER OVER "PROVOCATIONS": HARFUCH</u>

Mexico’s Security Cabinet laid out the chain of command behind the assassination of Uruapan mayor Carlos Manzo: Ramón Ángel Álvarez Ayala, "El R1," had "direct participation in the decision, planning and financing" of the hit, ordered because the CJNG took the mayor’s stance as a provocation.

Special forces captured him in Atotonilco El Alto, Jalisco.

Naming who gave the order, and putting them in a cell. That’s the policy.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>VULCAN’S DAMAGE IN QUINTANA ROO COULD HIT $7 BILLION</u>

The environmental ruling against Calica — the Mexican subsidiary of US-based Vulcan Materials — is devastating: 883 species of flora and fauna affected, 194 of them endangered, three cenotes destroyed and 14 more contaminated, over an impact area beyond 2,000 hectares in Solidaridad and Cozumel.

Total environmental damage could reach $7 billion, Contralínea reports.

An American company spent years blowing up the Riviera Maya’s limestone bedrock. Mexico is making it pay.

🇲🇽🎬 <u>MEXICO RAISES FILM FUNDING 25.6% — 358 PROJECTS</u>

Mexico’s film institute keeps growing: Imcine raised support for national cinema and audiovisual production 25.6% this year — 358 projects selected, up from 285 in 2025, with coverage now reaching 30 states.

"El aumento al presupuesto que recibió el Imcine permitió apoyar a un mayor número de proyectos," director Daniela Alatorre told La Jornada.

Culture as state policy, not as an afterthought.

🇲🇽🏠 <u>12 MILLION FAMILIES: SHEINBAUM’S HOUSING PLEDGE</u>

One in three Mexican families. That’s the reach of the housing plan Claudia Sheinbaum laid out in Huajuapan de León, Oaxaca: 12 million families will get support this sexenio — new homes, home improvement, credit restructuring, property titles.

"Cerca de una tercera parte de todas las familias mexicanas se va a beneficiar con este programa," she said at the Pueblos Hermanos development in the Mixteca, while delivering Viviendas para el Bienestar support.

The neoliberal housing model was fraud and ghost suburbs. This one hands out deeds.
